'''Tom Ercanbrack''' (also published as '''Tom Ercambrack''' and '''Tom Ercenbrack''') is a Star Wars CCG player from Utah who played at [[January 2000 Provo tournament]] on 29 January 2000 with TDIGWATT (Any Methods Necessary start), according to Matthew Jensen's tournament report (which spells him Ercambrack).<ref name="tr-d214">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-provo-utah-1-29-2000d214/ provo-utah-1-29-2000], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 31 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-provo-utah-1-29-2000d214/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
